summary: The source requests repeated full CSR row-kernel calls. Compiled host loop calls GOMP_parallel, increments its counter and compares to the saved requested count before its backedge. Outlined worker 0x1fa0 requests dynamic chunks, loops each row in each chunk, processes each CSR nonzero and writes its row output (or zero for empty rows).

source_evidence.claim: CSR arrays have nItems endpoint and kernel computes each row over stored bounds; timed loop repeats kernel for iterations.

compiled_evidence.claim: Clocked host repetition backedge at 0x1a31 checks saved count after call at 0x1a22. Worker 0x1fa0 dynamically obtains row ranges; 0x2080 walks rows, 0x20b0..0x20cc walks nonzeros and loads/multiplies/accumulates, output store at 0x20ce; zero-row path at 0x2038.
